cohort: The study included 356 mother-neonate dyads involving term neonates delivered via cesarean section at a tertiary hospital.
finding: Meconium-stained amniotic fluid and trial of labor were significantly associated with neonatal acidosis (umbilical arterial pH < 7.20) in term neonates delivered via cesarean section.
mod_finding: Among term neonates delivered via cesarean section, a trial of labor prior to delivery was significantly associated with neonatal acidosis.
